subject: Compliance add-ons — line-item pricing + potential credit for KMS/HSM
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@healthline.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Sullivan <ryan.sullivan@healthline.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons — line-item pricing request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HealthLine is very interested in Redwood for our inference layer. Procurement asked me to get an itemized view of compliance add-on pricing so legal and finance can model this into our financials. Specifically we need: audit logging (retention tiers), KMS/HSM integration (key ops & per-key pricing model), data residency (single-region vs multi-region), and HIPAA support (BAA + any associated engineering/setup fees).

Can you send a simple line-item quote with options for annual commitments (12/24 months) and any credits you’d consider for bundling Reserved Capacity + compliance add-ons? We are targeting a July Q3 pilot and would like to scope costs before the legal review.

Attached is our RFP summary (HL_RFP_2026.xlsx) with expected token volumes and retention requirements. A few asks up front:
- Do you have a per-key monthly charge for KMS or is it usage-based?
- Any minimum fee to enable HSM-backed keys?
- Can audit logs be routed to our S3 (we prefer to store logs) and do you charge per-GB exported?

If easier, Marcus and your security lead can join a quick call.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director, Cloud Platform Procurement
HealthLine Inc.
alice.chen@healthline.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: HL_RFP_2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@healthline.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — line-item pricing request

Hi Alice — thanks for the RFP and the clear asks. Looping in Marcus (commercial) and Aisha (security/PM) so you have both pricing and technical coverage.

Attached: Redwood_Compliance_Line_Items_20260605.pdf — quick line-item table and two bundle examples. High level highlights below (we can convert into an attached spreadsheet if you want line-by-line totals):

- Audit Logs
  - Base audit logging (30d retention): $0.03/GB/mo (includes ingestion + 30d retention)
  - Extended retention: $0.015/GB/mo for 90-365d tier (cold storage export option available)
  - Export to customer S3: one-time export setup $1,200 + $0.005/GB egress (if Redwood-initiated export). You can also configure cross-account write; we’ll provide role and manifest.

- KMS/HSM
  - KMS integration (bring-your-own-KMS): no per-key Redwood fee; nominal integration setup $1,500
  - Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys: $120/month per active key + $0.002 per key op (reads/wrap/unwrap) after a 10k-op included monthly allowance
  - HSM on-prem connector (for Private customers): larger engineering engagement; typical one-time project $25k-$40k depending on scope

- Data residency
  - Single-region (US-West) option: $0 setup, standard unit pricing applies
  - Multi-region residency (US-West + EU): $2,500/mo region premium + inter-region replication costs (est. $0.01/GB transferred between regions)

- HIPAA (BAA)
  - BAA execution: no recurring fee; one-time security review and scoping: $2,000 (waivable on 12+ month committed revenue)
  - Additional logging/retention engineering estimated at $6k for integration test plan if you need attested pipeline changes

Bundling guidance: 10–15% discount on compliance add-on line items when purchased with a 12-month Reserved Capacity commitment at $XXk+/mo. For a 24-month commit we can stretch to 18% on add-ons and consider a small onboarding credit against the one-time setup fees.

I’ve intentionally left slots for negotiable credits — Marcus, can you propose what we can commit to for the HealthLine pilot? Aisha, see technical Qs below from Alice — can you give a short note on S3 export pattern and per-key op definition?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 206-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Line_Items_20260605.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@healthline.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — line-item pricing request

Hi Alice — appreciate the clear asks and the RFP. I adjusted the commercial offer after reviewing your expected token volumes and the pilot ramp profile in the RFP. Key points:

- Proposal (pilot / 12-month):
  - Reserved Capacity baseline: $45k/mo (guaranteed throughput profile in RFP)
  - Compliance add-ons (discounted for bundle): 12% off standard list in Naomi's table if you commit to baseline for 12 months
    - Audit logging: $0.0264/GB/mo (applied after discount)
    - Managed HSM keys: $105/month per active key (discounted) + $0.0018 per key-op
    - Data residency: multi-region premium reduced to $2,000/mo for pilot customers
  - Waive the one-time BAA security review fee for 12-month committed revenue >= $500k ARR

- For HSM-heavy customers we can also offer a $10k onboarding credit to offset connector work if HealthLine signs within three weeks. That credit is applied to the first invoice and reduces the initial setup burden.

- I’ve created a draft commercial summary (Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_v2.xlsx) and a DocuSign envelope for standard SOW + addendum: https://docusign.com/rdw/agreements/RDW-5132

Next steps: if these numbers look reasonable I can send a formal quote and push a short SOW + addendum to legal. Also happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk Finance through the line items.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0146

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks Naomi and Marcus — this is helpful. A few follow-ups from legal/finance:

1) KMS/HSM credits: HealthLine will have high key churn on the pilot (dynamic key per customer). The $105/month/key is okay for a handful of keys but at scale will be material. Would Redwood consider an alternate tier: 50% discount on per-key monthly for keys beyond the first 25 active keys?

2) SOC2 / evidence: our audit team needs the SOC2 Type II report and a pointer to where you store audit logs for retention verification. Can Aisha confirm how Redwood stores audit logs and whether those exports can be hashed/manifested for our evidence chain?

3) DocuSign & Timing: The DocuSign link looks fine — can you hold the $10k onboarding credit open for two weeks while we finish procurement approvals? If yes, we’ll prioritize the SOW.

Would love a brief reply from Aisha on item #2 and confirmation on the KMS tier. If we can get the KMS concession and SOC2 artifacts the commercial team here is comfortable moving to SOW.

Best,
Alice
Director, Cloud Platform Procurement
HealthLine Inc.
